arguments.command:
python -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx')
exp = df.iloc[9:22][['Monthly Budget Template', 'Unnamed: 1', 'Unnamed: 2']].copy()
exp.columns = ['Category', 'Item', 'Amount']
exp = exp.dropna(subset=['Amount'])
exp['Amount'] = exp['Amount'].astype(float)
print(exp.to_string(index=False))
print()
by_cat = exp.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum()
print('--- By Category ---')
print(by_cat.to_string())
total = exp['Amount'].sum()
print()
print('TOTAL EXPENSES: \$%.2f' % total)
print('Number of expense line items:', len(exp))
print('Matches formula range C11:C22 (12 items).')
"
